control_requirements.observation: Head high near center; torso fills lower frame.
Crop, hair and asymmetric neckline do not uniquely establish a whole-body axis.
Visible chin and nostril underplanes corroborate a distinctly low view.
Camera azimuth and subject yaw are confounded in the mildly asymmetric face projection.
No dependable architectural horizon or gravity reference is visible.
Large near torso below the smaller high head.
Long hair hides the viewer-left shoulder and asymmetric neckline confounds torso rotation.
Lower body is absent; camera elevation cannot be separated from any torso pitch.
A sloped shoulder image line is visible, but exact torso roll is confounded by crop and pose.
Face and nose turn mildly toward viewer-left relative to the chest projection.
Chin raised and neck extended above the neckline.
Small apparent eye-line slope is confounded by perspective and asymmetric eyelid visibility.
Small horizontal head offset is subordinate if upper placement, crop and torso scale are held.
Viewer-right bare shoulder is visibly higher in the image than the hidden-side shoulder region.
The bare shoulder is visible but no unique near/far ordering of both shoulders is supported.
Eyes look down toward the low viewing position.
The giant illustrated mouth is above-left of the foreground head while the two figures overlap substantially.

omission_checks.tested_change: Replace the close low view and raised head with an eye-level neutral portrait.
source_evidence: Visible underplanes and large foreground torso.

omission_checks.tested_change: Hold low viewpoint and crop, lower chin and square the shoulder line.
changed_relations: Extended-neck read and high viewer-right shoulder are lost.
source_evidence: Raised chin and sloping shoulder line.

omission_checks.tested_change: Move the head a small amount horizontally while retaining high placement, low viewpoint, gaze, chin lift, shoulder slope and illustration overlap.
preserved_relations: Low-angle projection, full head visibility and large torso remain.
source_evidence: The modest horizontal offset is weaker than the crop and scale relations.

omission_checks.tested_change: Move the illustration far upward-left while keeping its mouth technically above-left.
changed_relations: The mouth or surrounding hair would leave the frame; giant-face overlap and broad side fragments disappear.
source_evidence: Large illustrated face intersects top and lies directly behind the foreground hair.

handoffs.requirement: Compile camera and crop before pose, then preserve every emitted explicit and implicit axis; uncertain physical axes have no isolated directive. Bind the high-risk illustration direction with subject/frame, illustration/frame and overlap/visibility relations.
